dataset_name: USGS/ANSS ComCat Seismicity Dataset (India / South Asia)
source_organization: United States Geological Survey (USGS) Earthquake Hazards Program / National Earthquake Information Center (NEIC)
coverage: Bbox [Lat 6.0 to 38.0, Lon 68.0 to 98.0] covering India, Himalayan Seismic Belt, and adjacent regional borders
license_conditions: Public Domain (U.S. Geological Survey / U.S. Government Work)
operational_note: Authoritative historical seismicity catalog. Used for seismic hazard proximity, fault-line damage correlation, and structural impact assessment in Disaster Mode.
